screens.label: implementation
screens.note: The paper prints only the valence item and scale (verbatim). All other screen wording is implementation wording, missing in the paper (issue iss-wording).
screens.intro: You are taking part in an online survey about life events. Answer each screen as you would for yourself. You will see screens one at a time.
screens.answer_format: Reply with a single number only.
screens.e1:
Event: {event}
What is the likelihood (0% to 100%) that this event will happen to you in the future?
screens.ebr:
Event: {event}
What is the likelihood (0% to 100%) that this event happens to an average person?
screens.br:
Event: {event}
The actual base rate for this event is {br}%.
screens.recall: Please write down the base rate you were just shown for this event: {event}
screens.recall_fix: That was not the correct base rate. The correct base rate for "{event}" is {br}%. Please enter that value.
screens.e2:
Event: {event}
What is the likelihood (0% to 100%) that this event will happen to you in the future?
screens.valence_item_verbatim: How would you feel about experiencing this event?
screens.valence_scale_verbatim: 1 = extremely negative, 2 = somewhat negative, 3 = neither positive nor negative, 4 = somewhat positive, 5 = extremely positive
